execution.ref: .agent/decisions/2026-10-04-GRAPHITE-ATTACKER-COOLING-L0.md; branch claude/attack-adapter-cooling-l0, built on #584 (codex/cooling-scoring-adapter at 4332ad6fe, which carries #569)
execution.description: Built cooling's Level 0 attack adapter in battery's shape: fifteen families over the eight Track A checks, the Test Lead's five cooling vectors, trained and genuinely distinct held-out controls, an oracle that runs every attempt against the real boundary and a vulnerable specimen, typed rebuild through experiment.admit with cooling's ChallengeScoring, NOT_RUN seams for every missing owner value and Levels 1 to 5, and twenty-one mutations; then ran the phase-4 dry run at cooling.

expected: The vectors would each map to one registered boundary that a single mutation can turn red, including the laminar-regime rule of the population screen.
observed: Every family held with its specimen firing, every control passed in both splits, all twenty-one mutations turned their guard red, and the phase-4 dry run at chip-cold-plate completed with no finding and no spend. Two facts were not as expected: inside the registered input box no case above the laminar bound keeps its hottest wall inside the coolant model (grid and random searches of the public closed-form screen found none), so the Reynolds rule never refuses a case alone and only a whole-screen mutation is caught; and three vectors (optimism, pressure under-prediction, group sacrifice) have a registered score effect but no registered tolerance, so their refusal side is a NOT_RUN seam naming the owner value.
keep: Map each Challenge vector to the boundary Carbon already registers, and declare the part that needs an unregistered tolerance as a NOT_RUN seam that names the owner value.
Breach tests read a pinned copy of a registered bound, never the live value, so a lifted bound is caught.
Patch the module the boundary reads at call time in every mutation, and print which attack breached, so a guard that goes red for the wrong reason is visible.
change: Extract the per-attempt reading (assess) into the neutral core after #584 lands; cooling now carries a copy of battery's.
A cooling Attacker grant is proposed, not committed; phase 4 accepts only GRAPHITE-GRANT-PHASE4, so a per-Challenge grant also needs the runner to accept it.
